scientific_integrity: All-order proof uses Jacobi interlacing, Chebyshev/cyclotomic zero exclusion and PBH; finite exact-modular tests corroborate but do not prove all n. Independent assessment not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed unweighted odd n >=5 distance-two chord only; no results for arbitrary edge weights, other chords, even n, perturbation robustness, or quantitative Gramians. Unindexed related literature and an inaccessible potentially relevant general-control source remain publication-priority risks.
title: One-chord odd cycles: every singleton controls except the triangle midpoint
